notes: A SORT executed in the range of a SORT input procedure: "If the range of the input procedure causes the execution of any MERGE, RETURN, or format 1 SORT statements, the EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist" (§2002:14.8.36.3 GR9; cite.py --check). The golden prints BEFORE-INNER and the run unit ends at the inner SORT (the DIVERGES re-probe of golden-2002-3 on main 63ab0c4ece printed AFTER-INNER and AFTER-OUTER, before this fix). EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE is Fatal (§2002 Table 14) and with checking enabled and no applicable USE procedure "execution of the run unit is terminated abnormally" (§2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 4; cite.py --check). The rule makes the results of the operation undefined, not the fatal procedure; there is no 2002 item for a MERGE or SORT statement, so at --std 2002 the guard does not hand the marked condition to the verb: DialectBehavior.SortMergeStatementDisposesItsFatalConditions (VCR row 7.80, kb/Work PB5612).
